title: Web Application Development
shortDescription: Build scalable and high-performance web applications using modern technologies.
fullDescription: We build web applications that stay fast as they grow: typed end to end, server-rendered where it matters, and structured so a new engineer can find their way around in an afternoon. Performance, accessibility and observability are part of the definition of done rather than a later cleanup pass.

deliverables.title: Product architecture
deliverables.description: Data model, rendering strategy, auth model and deployment topology agreed up front.

deliverables.title: Design system and UI
deliverables.description: A reusable component library so future screens stay visually consistent.

deliverables.title: API and data layer
deliverables.description: Typed contracts, validation at the boundary, migrations and seed data.

deliverables.title: CI/CD and monitoring
deliverables.description: Automated checks on every pull request, preview environments, error and performance tracking.

useCases: Customer portals and internal operations tools
Multi-tenant SaaS products with role-based access
Rebuilds of ageing applications that have stopped scaling
